params.prompt: Edit this exact locked-camera photograph to create a single realistic blackjack-dealing END POSE. Preserve Astrid's exact face, hair, black jacket, ivory blouse, room, lighting, skin colour, table and shoe. Change only her pose: she leans naturally toward screen-left, extending her anatomical right arm diagonally forward-left, placing ONE small blank white playing card on the inner-left table position. The card's center must be at image coordinate x=0.309,y=0.690 measured from the upper-left corner (this is a composition instruction; do not draw coordinates, numbers, labels, arrows or text). Her right index and middle fingertips visibly touch the near edge of that card in an anatomically correct professional release. Her left hand remains naturally near the shoe on screen-right, ready to prepare another card. The card stays flat on the felt, with perspective matching the table. Only one card, no other person, no added props, no duplicate hands, no camera change, no graphic overlays. Maintain photographic realism and all existing scene geometry. It is essential that her hand genuinely reaches the card at the requested location.

content.text: This tool provides an auto-updating generation widget for these jobs. Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

Note: adjustments applied — medias[0].role: "image" → "image_references" (Nano Banana 2 backend expects schema-key media roles).
